Shared test utilities.\n//!\n//! Repository-level tests run against *both* backends:\n//! - [`MemFs`] — fast, deterministic, supports injected faults;\n//! - [`RealFs`] on a temp directory — proves the actual on-disk format and\n//!   process-level locking work.\n\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse cas_store::server::serve_listener;\nuse cas_store::{Fault, FaultFs, MemFs, RealFs, Repository, Vfs};\n\n/// Distinct bytes -> distinct hashes.\npub fn block(seed: u8, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = vec![seed; size];\n    // Mix in the position so equal-sized seeds don't accidentally collide.\n    for (i, b) in v.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n        *b = b.wrapping_add((i % 251) as u8);\n    }\n    v\n}\n\n/// RAII temp directory removed on drop.\npub struct TempDir {\n    pub path: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl TempDir {\n    pub fn new(label: &str) -> Self {\n        let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos();\n        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n            \"cas-test-{label}-{}-{nanos}\",\n            std::process::id()\n        ));\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&path).unwrap();\n        TempDir { path }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Drop for TempDir {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.path);\n    }\n}\n\n/// One repository under test, with its supporting state.\npub struct RepoHarness {\n    pub repo: Repository,\n    /// Kept alive for the test (FaultFs wraps it; MemFs is shared).\n    _vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    _temp: Option<TempDir>,\n}\n\n/// Open a fresh in-memory repository.\npub fn mem_repo() -> RepoHarness {\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    RepoHarness {\n        repo,\n        _vfs: vfs,\n        _temp: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Open a fresh on-disk repository.\npub fn real_repo(label: &str) -> RepoHarness {\n    let temp = TempDir::new(label);\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(temp.path.join(\"store\"), vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    RepoHarness {\n        repo,\n        _vfs: vfs,\n        _temp: Some(temp),\n    }\n}\n\n/// In-memory repository whose I/O layer injects `faults`.\npub fn fault_repo(faults: Vec<Fault>) -> RepoHarness {\n    let mem = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(FaultFs::new(mem, faults));\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    RepoHarness {\n        repo,\n        _vfs: vfs,\n        _temp: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Run a test closure against both backends.\npub fn both_backends<F>(mut f: F)\nwhere\n    F: FnMut(&mut RepoHarness),\n{\n    let mut h = mem_repo();\n    f(&mut h);\n    drop(h);\n    let mut h = real_repo(\"both\");\n    f(&mut h);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// HTTP test harness\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct HttpServer {\n    pub addr: String,\n    shutdown: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,\n}\n\nimpl HttpServer {\n    pub fn start(repo: Repository) -> Self {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let shutdown = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));\n        let s2 = shutdown.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();\n            use std::io::ErrorKind;\n            let repo = Arc::new(repo);\n            loop {\n                if s2.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                    break;\n                }\n                match listener.accept() {\n                    Ok((stream, _)) => {\n                        let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n                        thread::spawn(move || {\n                            // The blocking handler expects blocking sockets.\n                            let _ = handle_blocking(stream, repo);\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(e) if e.kind() == ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {\n                        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => break,\n                }\n            }\n        });\n        HttpServer { addr, shutdown }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Drop for HttpServer {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        self.shutdown\n            .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n    }\n}\n\nfn handle_blocking(mut stream: TcpStream, repo: Arc<Repository>) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)))?;\n    // Reuse the library's connection loop by one-off: easiest is to read the\n    // request here and re-emit via the public serve path is not available, so\n    // we just replicate minimal dispatch through a tiny shim below.\n    crate::http_shim::handle(stream, repo)\n}\n\n/// Minimal HTTP/1.1 client for tests.\npub struct HttpResponse {\n    pub status: u16,\n    pub headers: Vec<(String, String)>,\n    pub body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nimpl HttpResponse {\n    pub fn text(&self) -> String {\n        String::from_utf8_lossy(&self.body).into_owned()\n    }\n    pub fn json_value(&self) -> serde_json::Value {\n        serde_json::from_slice(&self.body).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null)\n    }\n    pub fn header(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n        self.headers\n            .iter()\n            .find(|(k, _)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))\n            .map(|(_, v)| v.as_str())\n    }\n}\n\npub fn request(\n    addr: &str,\n    method: &str,\n    path: &str,\n    headers: &[(&str, &str)],\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> HttpResponse {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(15))).unwrap();\n    let mut req = format!(\"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: {addr}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\");\n    for (k, v) in headers {\n        req.push_str(&format!(\"{k}: {v}\\r\\n\"));\n    }\n    if !body.is_empty() && !headers.iter().any(|(k, _)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\")) {\n        req.push_str(&format!(\"Content-Length: {}\\r\\n\", body.len()));\n    }\n    req.push_str(\"\\r\\n\");\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.write_all(body).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];\n    loop {\n        match stream.read(&mut chunk) {\n            Ok(0) => break,\n            Ok(n) => raw.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]),\n            Err(ref e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut => break,\n            Err(e) => panic!(\"read error: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let split = raw.windows(4).position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap();\n    let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..split]).to_string();\n    let body = raw[split + 4..].to_vec();\n    let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let status = lines\n        .next()\n        .unwrap()\n        .split_whitespace()\n        .nth(1)\n        .unwrap()\n        .parse()\n        .unwrap();\n    let headers = lines\n        .filter_map(|l| l.split_once(':').map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.trim().to_string())))\n        .collect();\n    HttpResponse {\n        status,\n        headers,\n        body,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Suppress unused warning when `serve_listener` isn't {"parentUuid":"180e90f3-0c42-431d-b8e9-adab899a18d6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_rw6g8uctxnd0w17ityljkajh","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b/tests/roots.rs","content":"//! Named roots: atomic publish/switch, validation, listing/deletion.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::{block, both_backends, fault_repo};\nuse cas_store::{Fault, FaultOp, RealFs, Repository};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\n#[test]\nfn publish_and_switch_root() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let v1 = h.repo.add_block(b\"snapshot v1\", &[]).unwrap();\n        let v2 = h.repo.add_block(b\"snapshot v2\", &[]).unwrap();\n\n        let m1 = h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &v1.hash).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(m1.hash, v1.hash);\n        assert_eq!(h.repo.get_root(\"main\").unwrap().hash, v1.hash);\n\n        let m2 = h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &v2.hash).unwrap();\n        assert!(m2.published_at >= m1.published_at);\n        assert_eq!(h.repo.get_root(\"main\").unwrap().hash, v2.hash);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_must_point_at_existing_block() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let ghost = \"c\".repeat(64);\n        let err = h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &ghost).unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(\n            err,\n            cas_store::StoreError::MissingReference(_)\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.get_root(\"main\").unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::NotFound(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_name_validation() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let blk = h.repo.add_block(b\"x\", &[]).unwrap();\n        for bad in [\"\", \".\", \"..\", \".hidden\", \"a/b\", \"a\\\\b\"] {\n            assert!(matches!(\n                h.repo.put_root(bad, &blk.hash).unwrap_err(),\n                cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n            ));\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn list_and_delete_roots() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let b1 = h.repo.add_block(block(1, 10).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n        let b2 = h.repo.add_block(block(2, 10).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n        h.repo.put_root(\"alpha\", &b1.hash).unwrap();\n        h.repo.put_root(\"beta\", &b2.hash).unwrap();\n        let roots = h.repo.list_roots().unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(roots.len(), 2);\n        assert_eq!(roots[0].name, \"alpha\");\n        assert_eq!(roots[1].name, \"beta\");\n\n        h.repo.delete_root(\"alpha\").unwrap();\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.delete_root(\"alpha\").unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::NotFound(_)\n        ));\n        let roots = h.repo.list_roots().unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(roots.len(), 1);\n        assert_eq!(roots[0].name, \"beta\");\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_publish_crash_leaves_old_root_intact() {\n    // Inject a rename fault on the *second* rename of the root manifest:\n    // that's the republish of `main` (switch v1 -> v2) crashing at the worst\n    // instant.\n    let h = fault_repo(vec![Fault {\n        path_contains: \"/roots/main\",\n        op: FaultOp::Rename,\n        once: Some(2),\n    }]);\n    let v1 = h.repo.add_block(b\"snapshot v1\", &[]).unwrap();\n    let v2 = h.repo.add_block(b\"snapshot v2\", &[]).unwrap();\n\n    h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &v1.hash).unwrap();\n\n    // The switch fails exactly at rename — but the OLD root must remain\n    // readable and correct (atomic publication boundary).\n    let err = h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &v2.hash);\n    assert!(err.is_err(), \"expected injected rename failure\");\n    let current = h.repo.get_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(current.hash, v1.hash, \"old root must survive interrupted switch\");\n\n    // The repository is still fully usable; a clean retry publishes v2.\n    h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &v2.hash).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_root(\"main\").unwrap().hash, v2.hash);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_after_real_crash_simulation() {\n    // On the real FS: first process publishes v1; we manually plant a stale\n    // temp manifest in roots/ (crash between write and rename); reopen must\n    // show v1 and ignore/clean the temp file.\n    let tmp = common::TempDir::new(\"crash-reopen\");\n    let vfs = Arc::new(RealFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(tmp.path.join(\"store\"), vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    let v1 = repo.add_block(b\"v1\", &[]).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"main\", &v1.hash).unwrap();\n    drop(repo);\n\n    let roots = tmp.path.join(\"store/roots\");\n    std::fs::write(roots.join(\".tmp.1.partial\"), b\"{\\\"broken\\\":\").unwrap();\n\n    let repo = Repository::open(tmp.path.join(\"store\"), vfs).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.get_root(\"main\").unwrap().hash, v1.hash);\n    let leftover: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&roots)\n        .unwrap()\n        .map(|e| e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())\n        .filter(|n| n.starts_with(\".tmp.\"))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(leftover.is_empty(), \"stale temp manifest should be swept: {leftover:?}\");\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_402faef4c3651af02e2a59b8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2061,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":84792,"output_tokens":1462,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_rw6g8uctxnd0w17ityljkajh":{"content":"//! common;\n\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse cas_store::{MemFs, RealFs, Repository, Vfs};\nuse common::{block, both_backends, mem_repo, real_repo, RepoHarness, TempDir};\n\n/// Two disjoint trees sharing one common leaf.\n/// Returns (tree_a_root, tree_b_root, shared_leaf, orphan_root, all_hashes).\nfn build_scene(h: &RepoHarness) -> Scene {\n    let leaf_a = h.repo.add_block(block(1, 20).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n    let leaf_b = h.repo.add_block(block(2, 20).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n    let shared = h.repo.add_block(block(3, 20).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n\n    let ra = h\n        .repo\n        .add_block(\n            b\"treeA\",\n            &[leaf_a.hash.clone(), shared.hash.clone()],\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n    let rb = h\n        .repo\n        .add_block(\n            b\"treeB\",\n            &[leaf_b.hash.clone(), shared.hash.clone()],\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n    // Orphan: uploaded, never attached to any root.\n    let orphan = h.repo.add_block(b\"floating\", &[]).unwrap();\n\n    h.repo.put_root(\"a\", &ra.hash).unwrap();\n    h.repo.put_root(\"b\", &rb.hash).unwrap();\n\n    Scene {\n        root_a: ra.hash,\n        root_b: rb.hash,\n        leaf_a: leaf_a.hash,\n        leaf_b: leaf_b.hash,\n        shared: shared.hash,\n        orphan: orphan.hash,\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Scene {\n    root_a: String,\n    root_b: String,\n    leaf_a: String,\n    leaf_b: String,\n    shared: String,\n    orphan: String,\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dry_run_reports_but_keeps_everything() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let s = build_scene(h);\n        let r = h.repo.gc(true).unwrap();\n        assert!(r.dry_run);\n        assert_eq!(r.blocks_total, 6);\n        assert_eq!(r.reachable, 5);\n        assert_eq!(r.orphan, 1);\n        assert_eq!(r.removed, vec![s.orphan.clone()]);\n        assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&s.orphan), \"dry-run must not delete\");\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn sweep_removes_orphan_only() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let s = build_scene(h);\n        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        assert!(!r.dry_run);\n        assert_eq!(r.removed, vec![s.orphan.clone()]);\n        assert!(!h.repo.block_exists(&s.orphan));\n        // Everything reachable survives.\n        for alive in [\n            &s.root_a, &s.root_b, &s.leaf_a, &s.leaf_b, &s.shared,\n        ] {\n            assert!(h.repo.block_exists(alive), \"{alive} must survive\");\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn shared_leaf_survives_until_no_root_reaches_it() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let s = build_scene(h);\n        // Delete root a: leaf_a becomes garbage; shared is still reached by b.\n        h.repo.delete_root(\"a\").unwrap();\n        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        let removed: HashSet<&str> = r.removed.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();\n        // orphan from scene + root_a + leaf_a\n        assert!(removed.contains(s.orphan.as_str()));\n        assert!(removed.contains(s.root_a.as_str()));\n        assert!(removed.contains(s.leaf_a.as_str()));\n        assert!(!removed.contains(s.shared.as_str()), \"shared still reached by root b\");\n        assert!(!removed.contains(s.leaf_b.as_str()));\n        assert!(!removed.contains(s.root_b.as_str()));\n\n        // Delete root b as well: the rest is collected.\n        h.repo.delete_root(\"b\").unwrap();\n        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        let removed: HashSet<String> = r.removed.into_iter().collect();\n        assert!(removed.contains(&s.shared));\n        assert!(removed.contains(&s.leaf_b));\n        assert!(removed.contains(&s.root_b));\n        assert_eq!(h.repo.verify().unwrap().blocks_total, 0);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_switch_away_makes_old_tree_garbage_and_new_tree_live() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let s = build_scene(h);\n        // Switch root a from treeA onto treeB's root.\n        h.repo.put_root(\"a\", &s.root_b).unwrap();\n        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        let removed: HashSet<&str> = r.removed.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();\n        // leaf_a / root_a / orphan are now unreachable; shared still live.\n        assert!(removed.contains(s.root_a.as_str()));\n        assert!(removed.contains(s.leaf_a.as_str()));\n        assert!(removed.contains(s.orphan.as_str()));\n        assert!(!removed.contains(s.shared.as_str()));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_refs_are_reported_not_fatal_and_reachable_set_is_protected() {\n    // Manufacture a missing reference directly on the backend:\n    // root block's meta points at a child, then the child data is removed out\n    // from underneath (simulating lost files / partial replication).\n    let h = mem_repo();\n    let child = h.repo.add_block(b\"child\", &[]).unwrap();\n    let root = h\n        .repo\n        .add_block(b\"root\", &[child.hash.clone()])\n        .unwrap();\n    h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &root.hash).unwrap();\n\n    // Delete the child block and its sidecar *externally* via the same Vfs\n    // (bypassing repository rules), creating a dangling edge.\n    let child_path = h\n        .repo\n        .path()\n        .join(\"blocks\")\n        .join(&child.hash[0..2])\n        .join(&child.hash);\n    let child_meta = h\n        .repo\n        .path()\n        .join(\"blocks\")\n        .join(&child.hash[0..2])\n        .join(format!(\"{}.meta\", child.hash));\n    h._vfs.remove_file(&child_path).unwrap();\n    h._vfs.remove_file(&child_meta).unwrap();\n\n    let verify = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n    let dangling: Vec<_> = verify\n        .missing_refs\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|m| m.from == root.hash && m.target == child.hash)\n        .collect();\n    assert_eq!(dangling.len(), 1);\n\n    // GC must still run: the root itself is reachable and MUST be preserved;\n    // the hole is reported.\n    let gc = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n    assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&root.hash), \"reachable root must survive hole\");\n    assert!(\n        gc.missing_refs\n            .iter()\n            .any(|m| m.from == root.hash && m.target == child.hash),\n        \"GC should report the dangling edge: {:?}\",\n        gc.missing_refs\n    );\n    assert!(!gc.removed.contains(&root.hash));\n\n    // Root pointing directly at a missing block: reported as <root> edge and\n    // nothing panics.\n    h.repo.delete_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n    // Re-publish isn't allowed (block missing), so plant manifest externally:\n    let manifest = serde_json::json!({\n        \"root\": \"ghost\", \"hash\": child.hash, \"published_at\": 0\n    });\n    let roots_dir = h.repo.path().join(\"roots\");\n    let tmp = roots_dir.join(\".tmp.plant\");\n    use std::io::Write;\n    let mut f = h._vfs.create_new(&tmp).unwrap();\n    f.write_all(serde_json::to_vec(&manifest).unwrap()).unwrap();\n    drop(f);\n    h._vfs.rename(&tmp, &roots_dir.join(\"ghost\")).unwrap();\n\n    let gc = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n    assert!(\n        gc.missing_refs.iter().any(|m| m.from == \"<root>\" && m.target == child.hash),\n        \"missing root target should be reported: {:?}\",\n        gc.missing_refs\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_uploads_of_same_block_deduplicate() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(42, 4096);\n        let repo = Arc::new(h.repo.clone());\n        let mut handles = Vec::new();\n        for _ in 0..16 {\n            let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n            let data = data.clone();\n            handles.push(thread::spawn(move || repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap()));\n        }\n        let hashes: HashSet<String> = handles\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|jh| jh.join().unwrap().hash)\n            .collect();\n        assert_eq!(hashes.len(), 1, \"all uploads resolve to one hash\");\n        let hash = hashes.into_iter().iter().next().unwrap().clone();\n        assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block(&hash).unwrap(), data);\n        assert_eq!(h.repo.verify().unwrap().blocks_total, 1);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_uploads_of_a_tree_preserve_integrity() {\n    // Many threads build the same DAG (same content) in leaf-first order with\n    // retries: the repository must end with exactly the expected block set and\n    // zero integrity errors.\n    let h = mem_repo();\n    let repo = Arc::new(h.repo.clone());\n    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n    let mut handles = Vec::new();\n    for t in 0..8 {\n        let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n        let stop = Arc::clone(&stop);\n        handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            // Each thread uses unique content, so no dedup; total must be exact.\n            let mut mine = Vec::new();\n            for i in 0..20 {\n                let data = format!(\"t{t}-b{i}\").into_bytes();\n                let info = loop {\n                    match repo.add_block(&data, &mine) {\n                        Ok(info) => break info,\n                        // Refs may momentarily race; they don't for unique\n                        // content, but tolerate transient issues.\n                        Err(e) => panic!(\"unexpected error: {e}\"),\n                    }\n                };\n                mine.push(info.hash);\n            }\n            let _ = stop;\n            mine\n        }));\n    }\n    let mut total = 0;\n    for jh in handles {\n        total += jh.join().unwrap().len();\n    }\n    let v = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v.blocks_total, total);\n    assert!(v.corrupt.is_empty());\n    assert!(v.missing_refs.is_empty());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_never_removes_blocks_read_while_sweeping() {\n    // The headline concurrency invariant: readers continuously download every\n    // block reachable from the root while GC repeatedly runs and roots are\n    // switched. A successful read after a sweep proves the block wasn't\n    // unlinked out from under reachability.\n    let h = mem_repo();\n    let repo = Arc::new(h.repo.clone());\n\n    // Two live trees + a background \"backup\" root that pins the union, so the\n    // true reachable set never shrinks and we can assert every read succeeds.\n    let mut pinned: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..40u8 {\n        let info = repo.add_block(&block(i, 128), &[]).unwrap();\n        pinned.push(info.hash);\n    }\n    // parents in two groups\n    let pa = repo.add_block(b\"A\", &pinned[..20]).unwrap();\n    let pb = repo.add_block(b\"B\", &pinned[20..]).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"a\", &pa.hash).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"b\", &pb.hash).unwrap();\n    // backup pins everything\n    let pbackup = repo.add_block(b\"backup\", &pinned).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"backup\", &pbackup.hash).unwrap();\n\n    // Add throwaway orphans between sweeps.\n    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n\n    let mut readers = Vec::new();\n    for _ in 0..6 {\n        let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n        let pinned = pinned.clone();\n        let stop = Arc::clone(&stop);\n        readers.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut rounds = 0;\n            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                for h in &pinned {\n                    // verified read: bytes present AND correct\n                    let data = repo.get_block_verified(h).expect(\"reachable block deleted mid-read\");\n                    assert_eq!(cas_store::hash::sha256_hex(&data), *h);\n                }\n                rounds += 1;\n            }\n            rounds\n        }));\n    }\n\n    let mut switchers = Vec::new();\n    for _ in 0..2 {\n        let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n        let stop = Arc::clone(&stop);\n        switchers.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut n = 0;\n            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                // flip a and b between each other's trees (both stay pinned by\n                // backup regardless)\n                let target = if n % 2 == 0 { &pb.hash } else { &pa.hash };\n                repo.put_root(\"a\", target).unwrap();\n                let target = if n % 2 == 0 { &pa.hash } else { &pb.hash };\n                repo.put_root(\"b\", target).unwrap();\n                n += 1;\n            }\n            n\n        }));\n    }\n\n    let collector = {\n        let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n        let stop = Arc::clone(&stop);\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut swept = 0;\n            let mut any_removed = false;\n            for _ in 0..30 {\n                // Continuously create orphan garbage for the sweeper.\n                for k in 0..5 {\n                    let junk = format!(\"junk-{swept}-{k}-{}\", std::process::id()).into_bytes();\n                    let _ = repo.add_block(&junk, &[]);\n                }\n                let r = repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n                assert!(\n                    !r.removed.iter().any(|x| pinned_contains(&pinned, x) || x == pa.hash || x == pb.hash || x == pbackup.hash),\n                    \"GC removed reachable block: {:?}\",\n                    r.removed\n                );\n                if !r.removed.is_empty() {\n                    any_removed = true;\n                }\n                swept += 1;\n            }\n            stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n            (swept, any_removed)\n        })\n    };\n\n    let (sweeps, any_removed) = collector.join().unwrap();\n    assert!(sweeps >= 30);\n    assert!(any_removed, \"test is vacuous if GC never removed orphans\");\n    let total_rounds: usize = readers.into_iter().map(|j| j.join().unwrap()).sum();\n    let switches: usize = switchers.into_iter().map(|j| j.join().unwrap()).sum();\n    assert!(total_rounds > 0);\n    assert!(switches > 0);\n\n    // Final state: pinned blocks intact, zero junk left.\n    for hsh in &pinned {\n        assert!(repo.block_exists(hsh));\n    }\n    let v = repo.verify().unwrap();\n    assert!(v.corrupt.is_empty());\n}\n\nfn pinned_contains(v: &[String], x: &str) -> bool {\n    v.iter().any(|s| s == x)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_with_concurrent_root_switch_reachable_never_lost_without_backup() {\n    // Without a backup root: at every instant, exactly the current roots'\n    // blocks are reachable. We assert the invariant point-in-time by\n    // serializing observations: after each (switch, gc) pair, blocks reached\n    // by the current roots must all exist.\n    let h = mem_repo();\n    let mut sets: Vec<(String, Vec<String>)> = Vec::new();\n    for t in 0..6 {\n        let mut hashes = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0..8 {\n            let info = h\n                .repo\n                .add_block(format!(\"tree{t}-leaf{i}\").as_bytes(), &[])\n                .unwrap();\n            hashes.push(info.hash);\n        }\n        let root = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(format!(\"root{t}\").as_bytes(), &hashes)\n            .unwrap();\n        sets.push((root.hash, hashes));\n    }\n    h.repo.put_root(\"live\", &sets[0].0).unwrap();\n\n    for step in 0..sets.len() {\n        h.repo.put_root(\"live\", &sets[step].0).unwrap();\n        let report = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        // Currently published tree must be fully intact.\n        for leaf in &sets[step].1 {\n            assert!(h.repo.block_exists(leaf), \"step {step}: live leaf deleted\");\n            assert!(!report.removed.contains(leaf));\n        }\n        assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&sets[step].0));\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_fs_gc_and_reopen_roundtrip() {\n    let h = real_repo(\"gc-reopen\");\n    let keep = h.repo.add_block(b\"keep\", );\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_67dcbe62205b56885a73d965","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1524,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":86840,"output_tokens":4769,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_rhfxbkuvlzrucrgxewbgpp69":{"content":"//! });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_uploads_of_a_tree_preserve_integrity() {\n    // Many threads build the same DAG (same content) in leaf-first order with\n    // retries: the repository must end with unique content, so no dedup; total must be exact.\n            let mut mine = Vec::new();\n            for i in 0..20 {\n                let data = format!(\"t{t}-b{i}\").into_bytes();\n unique\n                        // content, but tolerate transient issues.\n                        Err(e) => panic!(\"unexpected error: {e}\"),\n                    }\n                };\n assert!(v.missing_refs.is_empty());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_never_removes_blocks_read_while_sweeping() {\n    // The headline concurrency invariant: readers continuously download every\n    // block everything\n    let pbackup = repo.add_block(b\"backup\", &pinned).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"backup\", &pbackup.hash).unwrap();\n\n    // Add throwaway orphans between sweeps.\n    let stop = assert_eq!(v.blocks_total, 0);\n    // Retry succeeds.\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn data = block(2, 64);\n    assert!(h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).is_err());\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupted_block_on_disk_is_detected() {\n    // Tamper with bytes after publication: verified reads and /verify catch it.\n    let h = real_repo(\"corrupt\");\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(b\"original content here\", &[]).unwrap();\n    let data_path = h\n        ._temp\n        .as_ref()\n        .unwrap()\n        .path\n        .join(\"store/blocks\")\n        .join(&info.hash[0..2])\n        .join(&info.hash);\n\n    // Direct overwrite of immutable bytes (simulates disk corruption /\n    // malicious local modification).\n    let mut bytes = std::fs::read(&data_path).unwrap();\n    bytes[0] ^= 0xff;\n    std::fs::write(&data_path, bytes).unwrap();\n\n    // Plain read returns corrupted bytes (store can't know unless asked)...\n    let raw = h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap();\n    assert_ne!(raw, b\"original content here\");\n    // ...but verified reads and the integrity scan MUST detect it.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap_err(),\n        cas_store::StoreError::Corrupt { .. }\n    ));\n    let v = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n Failure injection (via [`FaultFs`]) and integrity enforcement.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::io::Write;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse cas_store::{Fault, FaultOp, MemFs, RealFs, Repository};\nuse common::{block, real_repo};\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_fault_surfaces_and_repo_stays_usable() {\n    // Fail the very first write (block data temp file) once.\n    let h = common::fault_repo(vec![Fault {\n        path_contains: \"/blocks/\",\n        op: FaultOp::Write,\n        once: Some(1),\n    }]);\n    let data = block(1, 128);\n    let first = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]);\n    assert!(first.is_err(), \"injected write fault must propagate\");\n    // No half-published block exists.\n    let v = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v.blocks_total, 0);\n    // Retry succeeds.\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_create_fault_is_recoverable() {\n    let h = common::fault_repo(vec![Fault {\n        path_contains: \"/blocks/\",\n        op: FaultOp::Create,\n        once: Some(1),\n    }]);\n    let data = block(2, 64);\n    assert!(h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).is_err());\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupted_block_on_disk_is_detected() {\n    // Tamper with bytes after publication: verified reads and /verify catch it.\n    let h = real_repo(\"corrupt\");\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(b\"original content here\", &[]).unwrap();\n    let data_path = h\n        ._temp\n        .as_ref()\n        .unwrap()\n        .path\n        .join(\"store/blocks\")\n        .join(&info.hash[0..2])\n        .join(&info.hash);\n\n    // Direct overwrite of immutable bytes (simulates disk corruption /\n    // malicious local modification).\n    let mut bytes = std::fs::read(&data_path).unwrap();\n    bytes[0] ^= 0xff;\n    std::fs::write(&data_path, bytes).unwrap();\n\n    // Plain read returns corrupted bytes (store can't know unless asked)...\n    let raw = h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap();\n    assert_ne!(raw, b\"original content here\");\n    // ...but verified reads and the integrity scan MUST detect it.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap_err(),\n        cas_store::StoreError::Corrupt { .. }\n    ));\n    let v = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n    assert!(v.corrupt.contains(&info.hash));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopening_corrupt_format_marker_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = common::TempDir::new(\"bad-format\");\n    let store = dir.path.join(\"store\");\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(store.join(\"blocks\")).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(store.join(\"format\"), b\"something else v9\\n\").unwrap();\n    let err = Repository::open(store, Arc::new(RealFs::new())).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, cas_store::StoreError::NotARepository(_)));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dedup_of_corrupted_existing_block_is_reported_corrupt() {\n    let h = real_repo(\"dedup-corrupt\");\n    let data = block(5, 256);\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    let p = h\n        ._temp\n        .as_ref()\n        .unwrap()\n        .path\n        .join(\"store/blocks\")\n        .join(&info.hash[0..2])\n        .join(&info.hash);\n    let mut b = std::fs::read(&p).unwrap();\n    b[0] ^= 0x01;\n    std::fs::write(&p, b).unwrap();\n    // Re-uploading identical (correct) content finds corrupt existing bytes.\n    let err = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, cas_store::StoreError::Corrupt { .. }));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn memfs_atomic_publish_has_no_torn_observability() {\n    // Repeated root republishing under MemFs: readers must only ever see a\n    // parseable manifest pointing at an existing block.\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\n    let h = common::mem_repo();\n    let mut hashes = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..10 {\n        hashes.push(h.repo.add_block(format!(\"v{i}\").as_bytes(), &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n    h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &hashes[0]).unwrap();\n\n    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n    let repo = Arc::new(h.repo.clone());\n    let reader = {\n        let repo = Arc::clone(&repo);\n        let stop = Arc::clone(&stop);\n        let hashes = hashes.clone();\n        std::thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut checks = 0;\n            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                if let Ok(m) = repo.get_root(\"main\") {\n                    assert!(hashes.contains(&m.hash), \"observed invalid root state\");\n                    assert!(repo.block_exists(&m.hash));\n                }\n                checks += 1;\n            }\n            checks\n        })\n    };\n    for (i, hsh) in hashes.iter().enumerate() {\n        h.repo.put_root(\"main\", hsh).unwrap();\n        let _ = i;\n    }\n    stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    assert!(reader.join().unwrap() > 0);\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"feb2a8fe-dad8-45a4-9914-34ba48ce6df2","session_id":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b","sessionId":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp5-b","slug":"swift-strolling-fairy"}

{"parentUuid":"4cd6564c-c6ad-4d8d-af81-cb027b47d198","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_52vnzus2iqueetvov6eh2ycl","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b/tests/http_api.rs","content":"//! End-to-end tests against the real HTTP/1.1 protocol (ephemeral port).\n\nmod common;\n\nuse cas_store::{MemFs, Repository};\nuse common::{block, mem_repo, request, HttpServer};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nfn start() -> (HttpServer, Repository) {\n    let h = mem_repo();\n    let repo = h.repo.clone();\n    let server = HttpServer::start(h.repo);\n    (server, repo)\n}\n\nfn post_raw(addr: &str, path: &str, data: &[u8], refs: &[String]) -> common::HttpResponse {\n    let xrefs = refs.join(\",\");\n    let headers: Vec<(&str, &str)> = if refs.is_empty() {\n        vec![(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")]\n    } else {\n        vec![\n            (\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\"),\n            (\"X-Refs\", &xrefs),\n        ]\n    };\n    request(addr, \"POST\", path, &headers, data)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn health_and_index() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/healthz\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"status\"], \"ok\");\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.text().contains(\"POST   /blocks\"));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn upload_download_and_head_over_http() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n    let data = block(1, 500);\n\n    // POST /blocks (server computes hash)\n    let r = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", &data, &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.text());\n    let hash = r.json_value()[\"hash\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"deduplicated\"], false);\n\n    // Dedup\n    let r = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", &data, &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"deduplicated\"], true);\n\n    // GET raw\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.body, data);\n\n    // HEAD reports size\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"HEAD\", &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.header(\"Content-Length\").unwrap(), \"500\");\n    assert_eq!(r.header(\"X-Content-Sha256\").unwrap(), hash);\n\n    // GET ?verify=1\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}?verify=1\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.body, data);\n\n    // 404\n    let ghost = \"0\".repeat(64);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{ghost}\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 404);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"error\"], \"not_found\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn put_block_with_wrong_address_is_rejected() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n    let wrong = \"a\".repeat(64);\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        &format!(\"/blocks/{wrong}\"),\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n        b\"data\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400, \"{}\", r.text());\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"error\"], \"hash_mismatch\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn put_block_correct_address_json_hex() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n    let data = b\"json body content\";\n    let hash = cas_store::hash::sha256_hex(data);\n    let body = serde_json::json!({\"data\": hex_encode(data), \"refs\": []});\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}\"),\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n        serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.text());\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.body, data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn refs_missing_returns_409() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n    let ghost = \"d\".repeat(64);\n    let r = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", b\"child-who\", &[ghost]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"{}\", r.text());\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"error\"], \"missing_reference\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_lifecycle_and_gc_over_http() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n\n    // Two leaf blocks, one parent\n    let l1 = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", b\"leaf1\", &[]);\n    let l2 = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", b\"leaf2\", &[]);\n    let h1 = l1.json_value()[\"hash\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    let h2 = l2.json_value()[\"hash\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    let parent = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", b\"parent\", &[h1.clone(), h2.clone()]);\n    assert_eq!(parent.status, 200, \"{}\", parent.text());\n    let hp = parent.json_value()[\"hash\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n\n    // Orphan block\n    let orphan = post_raw(&s.addr, \"/blocks\", b\"orphan\", &[]);\n    let ho = orphan.json_value()[\"hash\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n\n    // Publish root via X-Block-Hash\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/main\",\n        &[(\"X-Block-Hash\", &hp)],\n        &[],\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.text());\n\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/roots/main\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"hash\"], hp);\n\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/roots\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[0][\"name\"], \"main\");\n\n    // Root at missing block -> 409\n    let ghost = \"e\".repeat(64);\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/bad\",\n        &[(\"X-Block-Hash\", &ghost)],\n        &[],\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n\n    // GC dry run: orphan listed, kept\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/gc?dry_run=1\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"orphan\"], 1);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"removed\"][0], ho);\n    let check = request(&s.addr, \"HEAD\", &format!(\"/blocks/{ho}\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(check.status, 200);\n\n    // Real sweep removes orphan, keeps reachable three\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/gc?dry_run=0\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"removed\"][0], ho);\n    for alive in [&h1, &h2, &hp] {\n        let r = request(&s.addr, \"HEAD\", &format!(\"/blocks/{alive}\"), &[], &[]);\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{alive} reachable but missing\");\n    }\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"HEAD\", &format!(\"/blocks/{ho}\"), &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 404);\n\n    // Delete root -> everything collectable on next GC\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"DELETE\", \"/roots/main\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/gc?dry_run=0\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"orphan\"], 3);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"reachable\"], 0);\n\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/verify\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"blocks_total\"], 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_clients_uploading_same_block() {\n    let (s, _repo) = start();\n    let data = block(9, 4096);\n    let addr = s.addr.clone();\n    let mut handles = Vec::new();\n    for _ in 0..12 {\n        let addr = addr.clone();\n        let data = data.clone();\n        handles.push(std::thread::spawn(move || {\n            let r = post_raw(&addr, \"/blocks\", &data, &[]);\n            assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.text());\n            r.json_value()[\"hash\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()\n        }));\n    }\n    let hashes: std::collections::HashSet<String> =\n        handles.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect();\n    assert_eq!(hashes.len(), 1);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/verify\", &[], &[]);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"blocks_total\"], 1);\n    assert_eq!(r.json_value()[\"ok\"], 1);\n}\n\nfn hex_encode(b: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut s = String::with_capacity(b.len() * 2);\n    for x in b {\n        use std::fmt::Write;\n        let _ = write!(s, \"{x:02x}\");\n    }\n    s\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_fce124f84aa93d23b3c550ee","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1797,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":92984,"output_tokens":2668,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_52vnzus2iqueetvov6eh2ycl":{"content":"//! Shared test utilities.\n//!\n//! Repository-level tests run against *both* backends:\n//! - [`MemFs`] — fast, deterministic, supports injected faults;\n//! - [`RealFs`] on a temp directory — proves the actual on-disk format and\n//!   process-level locking work.\n\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\nuse vec![seed; size];\n    // Mix in the position so equal-sized seeds don't accidentally collide.\n    for (i, b) in v.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n        *b = b.wrapping_add((i % 251) as u8);\n    }\n {\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    RepoHarness {\n        repo,\n        _vfs: vfs,\n        _temp: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Open a fresh on-disk repository.\npub fn real_repo(label: &str) -> RepoHarness {\n    let temp = TempDir::new(label);\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(RealFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(temp.path.join(\"store\"), vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    RepoHarness {\n        repo,\n        _vfs: vfs,\n        _temp: Some(temp),\n    }\n}\n\n/// In-memory repository whose I/O layer injects `faults`.\npub fn fault_repo(faults: Vec<Fault>) -> RepoHarness {\n    let mem = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(FaultFs::new(mem, faults));\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs.clone()).unwrap();\n    RepoHarness {\n        repo,\n        _vfs: vfs,\n        _temp: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Run a test closure against both backends.\npub fn both_backends<F>(mut f: F)\nwhere\n    F: FnMut(&mut RepoHarness),\n{\n    let mut h = mem_repo();\n    f(&mut h);\n    drop(h);\n    let mut h = real_repo(\"both\");\n    f(&mut h);\n}\n\n// TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let shutdown = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));\n        let s2 = shutdown.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();\n            use std::io::ErrorKind;\n            let repo = Arc::new(repo);\n            loop {\n                if s2.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                    break;\n                }\n                match listener.accept() {\n                    Ok((stream, Failure injection (via [`FaultFs`]) and integrity enforcement.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse cas_store::{Fault, FaultOp, RealFs, Repository};\nuse common::{block, real_repo};\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_fault_surfaces_and_repo_stays_usable() {\n    // Fail the very first write (block data temp file) once.\n    let h = common::fault_repo(vec![Fault {\n        path_contains: \"/blocks/\",\n        op: FaultOp::Write,\n        once: Some(1),\n    }]);\n    let data = block(1, 128);\n    let first = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]);\n    assert!(first.is_err(), \"injected write fault must propagate\");\n    // No half-published block exists.\n    let v = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v.blocks_total, 0);\n    // Retry succeeds.\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_create_fault_is_recoverable() {\n    let h = common::fault_repo(vec![Fault {\n        path_contains: \"/blocks/\",\n        op: FaultOp::Create,\n        once: Some(1),\n    }]);\n    let data = block(2, 64);\n    assert!(h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).is_err());\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupted_block_on_disk_is_detected() {\n    // Tamper with bytes after publication: verified reads and /verify catch it.\n    let h = real_repo(\"corrupt\");\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(b\"original content here\", &[]).unwrap();\n    let data_path = h\n        .temp\n        .as_ref()\n        .unwrap()\n        .path\n        .join(\"store/blocks\")\n        .join(&info.hash[0..2])\n        .join(&info.hash);\n\n    // Direct overwrite of immutable bytes (simulates disk corruption /\n    // malicious local modification).\n    let mut bytes = std::fs::read(&data_path).unwrap();\n    bytes[0] ^= 0xff;\n    std::fs::write(&data_path, bytes).unwrap();\n\n    // Plain read returns corrupted bytes (store can't know unless asked)...\n    let raw = h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap();\n    assert_ne!(raw, b\"original content here\");\n    // ...but verified reads and the integrity scan MUST detect it.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap_err(),\n        cas_store::StoreError::Corrupt { .. }\n    ));\n    let v = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n    assert!(v.corrupt.contains(&info.hash));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopening_corrupt_format_marker_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = common::TempDir::new(\"bad-format\");\n    let store = dir.path.join(\"store\");\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(store.join(\"blocks\")).unwrap();\n    std::fs::write(store.join(\"format\"), b\"something else v9\\n\").unwrap();\n    let err = Repository::open(store, Arc::new(RealFs::new())).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, cas_store::StoreError::NotARepository(_)));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dedup_of_corrupted_existing_block_is_reported_corrupt() {\n    let h = real_repo(\"dedup-corrupt\");\n    let data = block(5, 256);\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n    let p = h\n        .temp\n        .as_ref()\n        .unwrap()\n        .path\n        .join(\"store/blocks\")\n        .join(&info.hash[0..2])\n        .join(&info.hash);\n    let mut b = std::fs::read(&p).unwrap();\n    b[0] ^= 0x01;\n    std::fs::write(&p, b).unwrap();\n    // Re-uploading identical (correct) content finds corrupt existing bytes.\n    let err = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, cas_store::StoreError::Corrupt { .. }));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn memfs_atomic_publish_has_no_torn_observability() {\n    // Repeated root republishing under MemFs: readers must only ever see a\n    // parseable manifest pointing at an existing block.\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\n    let h = common::mem_repo();\n    let mut hashes = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..10 {\n        hashes.push(h.repo.add_block(format!(\"v{i}\").as_bytes(), &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n leaf a/b, parent referencing both.\nfn build_tree(h: &RepoHarness) -> (String, String, String) {\n    let a = block(1, 64);\n    let b = block(2, 64);\n    let ia = h.repo.add_block(&a, &[]).unwrap();\n    let ib = h.repo.add_block(&b, &[]).unwrap();\n    let parent_data = format!(\"children of v1\");\n    let ip = h\n        .repo\n        .add_block(parent_data.as_bytes(), &[ia.hash.clone(), ib.hash.clone()])\n        .unwrap();\n    (ia.hash, ib.hash, ip.hash)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn store_read_roundtrip_on_both_backends() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(7, 1024);\n        let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(info.size, 1024);\n        assert!(!info.deduplicated);\n        let got = h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(got, data);\n        let got = h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(got, data);\n        assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&info.hash));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn identical_content_deduplicates() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(9, 200);\n        let first = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n        let second = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(first.hash, second.hash);\n        assert!(second.deduplicated);\n        assert_eq!(second.size, data.len() as u64);\n        // Total blocks is one — GC sees a single node, and enumeration dedups.\n        let report = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(report.blocks_total, 1);\n        assert_eq!(report.ok, 1);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn refs_are_stored_and_traversed() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let (a, b, p) = build_tree(h);\n        // parent must be reachable through refs; verify reports no dangling.\n        let r = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n        assert!(r.missing_refs.is_empty(), \"unexpected: {:?}\", r.missing_refs);\n        assert_eq!(r.blocks_total, 3);\n        // uploading parent without its children is rejected\n        let orphan_parent = b\"no children here\";\n        let missing = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(orphan_parent, &[a.clone(), b.clone(), p.clone()])\n            .unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(\n            missing,\n            cas_store::StoreError::MissingReference(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dedup_upload_merges_new_refs() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let leaf = block(3, 32);\n        let i_leaf = h.repo.add_block(&leaf, &[]).unwrap();\n        let shared = block(4, 32);\n        let i1 = h.repo.add_block(&shared, &[]).unwrap();\n        // Re-upload identical `shared`, now declaring the leaf as a ref.\n        let i2 = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(&shared, &[i_leaf.hash.clone()])\n            .unwrap();\n        assert!(i2.deduplicated);\n        assert_eq!(i2.hash, i1.hash);\n        assert!(i2.refs.contains(&i_leaf.hash));\n        let r = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n        assert!(r.missing_refs.is_empty());\n        assert_eq!(r.blocks_total, 2);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn named_put_rejects_wrong_hash() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(5, 16);\n        let wrong = \"a\".repeat(64);\n        let err = h.repo.add_block_named(&wrong, &data, &[]).unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(\n            err,\n            cas_store::StoreError::HashMismatch { .. }\n        ));\n        // Correct address works.\n        let real = cas_store::hash::sha256_hex(&data);\n        let info = h.repo.add_block_named(&real, &data, &[]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(info.hash, real);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn malformed_hashes_and_empty_blocks_rejected() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.get_block(\"nope\").unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.add_block(&[], &[]).unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.add_block(b\"x\", &[\"zz\".repeat(64)]).unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_block_is_not_found() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let h64 = \"f\".repeat(64);\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.get_block(&h64).unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::NotFound(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_persists_real_backend_and_repairs_tmp() {\n    use cas_store::{RealFs, Repository};\n    use std::sync::Arc;\n    let h = real_repo(\"reopen\");\n    let data = block(11, 50);\n    let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n\n    // Simulate a crashed write: leave a temp file lying in the shard dir.\n    let shard = h.temp.as_ref().unwrap().path.join(\"store/blocks\");\n    let shard_dir = shard.join(&info.hash[0..2]);\n    std::fs::write(shard_dir.join(\".tmp.999.deadbeef\"), b\"partial\").unwrap();\n\n Block storage basics: content addressing, dedup, refs, integrity checks.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::{block, both_backends, mem_repo, real_repo, RepoHarness};\n\n/// Build a small two-level tree: leaf a/b, parent referencing both.\nfn build_tree(h: &RepoHarness) -> (String, String, String) {\n    let a = block(1, 64);\n    let b = block(2, 64);\n    let ia = h.repo.add_block(&a, &[]).unwrap();\n    let ib = h.repo.add_block(&b, &[]).unwrap();\n    let parent_data = format!(\"children of v1\");\n    let ip = h\n        .repo\n        .add_block(parent_data.as_bytes(), &[ia.hash.clone(), ib.hash.clone()])\n        .unwrap();\n    (ia.hash, ib.hash, ip.hash)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn store_read_roundtrip_on_both_backends() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(7, 1024);\n        let info = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(info.size, 1024);\n        assert!(!info.deduplicated);\n        let got = h.repo.get_block(&info.hash).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(got, data);\n        let got = h.repo.get_block_verified(&info.hash).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(got, data);\n        assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&info.hash));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn identical_content_deduplicates() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(9, 200);\n        let first = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n        let second = h.repo.add_block(&data, &[]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(first.hash, second.hash);\n        assert!(second.deduplicated);\n        assert_eq!(second.size, data.len() as u64);\n        // Total blocks is one — GC sees a single node, and enumeration dedups.\n        let report = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(report.blocks_total, 1);\n        assert_eq!(report.ok, 1);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn refs_are_stored_and_traversed() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let (a, b, p) = build_tree(h);\n        // parent must be reachable through refs; verify reports no dangling.\n        let r = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n        assert!(r.missing_refs.is_empty(), \"unexpected: {:?}\", r.missing_refs);\n        assert_eq!(r.blocks_total, 3);\n        // uploading a block with non-existent refs is rejected\n        let ghost1 = \"1\".repeat(64);\n        let ghost2 = \"2\".repeat(64);\n        let missing = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(b\"no children here\", &[ghost1, ghost2])\n            .unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(\n            missing,\n            cas_store::StoreError::MissingReference(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dedup_upload_merges_new_refs() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let leaf = block(3, 32);\n        let i_leaf = h.repo.add_block(&leaf, &[]).unwrap();\n        let shared = block(4, 32);\n        let i1 = h.repo.add_block(&shared, &[]).unwrap();\n        // Re-upload identical `shared`, now declaring the leaf as a ref.\n        let i2 = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(&shared, &[i_leaf.hash.clone()])\n            .unwrap();\n        assert!(i2.deduplicated);\n        assert_eq!(i2.hash, i1.hash);\n        assert!(i2.refs.contains(&i_leaf.hash));\n        let r = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n        assert!(r.missing_refs.is_empty());\n        assert_eq!(r.blocks_total, 2);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn named_put_rejects_wrong_hash() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        let data = block(5, 16);\n        let wrong = \"a\".repeat(64);\n        let err = h.repo.add_block_named(&wrong, &data, &[]).unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(\n            err,\n            cas_store::StoreError::HashMismatch { .. }\n        ));\n        // Correct address works.\n        let real = cas_store::hash::sha256_hex(&data);\n        let info = h.repo.add_block_named(&real, &data, &[]).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(info.hash, real);\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn malformed_hashes_and_empty_blocks_rejected() {\n    both_backends(|h| {\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.get_block(\"nope\").unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.add_block(&[], &[]).unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(\n            h.repo.add_block(b\"x\", &[\"zz\".repeat(64)]).unwrap_err(),\n            cas_store::StoreError::InvalidRequest(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn cas_store::StoreError::NotFound(_)\n        ));\n    });\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_persists_real_backend_and_repairs_tmp() {\n    use cas_store::{RealFs, Repository};\n    use std::sync::Arc;\n    let Scratch reproduction (not a committed test).\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse cas_store::{MemFs, Repository};\nuse cas_store::Vfs;\n\nfn block(seed: u8, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = vec![seed; size];\n    for (i, b) in v.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n        *b = b.wrapping_add((i % 251) as u8);\n    }\n    v\n}\n\nfn main() {\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs).unwrap();\n    let repo = Arc::new(repo);\n\n    let mut pinned = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..40u8 {\n        pinned.push(repo.add_block(&block(i, 128), &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n    let pa = repo.add_block(b\"A\", &pinned[..20]).unwrap();\n    let pb = repo.add_block(b\"B\", &pinned[20..]).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"a\", &pa.hash).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"b\", &pb.hash).unwrap();\n    let pbackup = repo.add_block(b\"backup\", &pinned).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"backup\", &pbackup.hash).unwrap();\n\n    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n\n    // readers\n    let mut readers = vec![];\n    for _ in 0..6 {\n        let repo = repo.clone();\n        let pinned = pinned.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        readers.push(thread::spawn(move || loop {\n            if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { break; }\n            for h in &pinned {\n                let _ = repo.get_block_verified(h);\n            }\n        }));\n    }\n    // switcher\n    {\n        let repo = repo.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        let ha = pa.hash.clone();\n        let hb = pb.hash.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut n = 0;\n            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &hb } else { &ha };\n                if repo.put_root(\"a\", t).is_err() { break; }\n                let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &ha } else { &hb };\n                if repo.put_root(\"b\", t).is_err() { break; }\n                n += 1;\n            }\n        });\n    }\n\n    for sweep in 0..30 {\n        for k in 0..5 {\n            let junk = format!(\"junk-{sweep}-{k}\").into_bytes();\n            let _ = repo.add_block(&junk, &[]);\n        }\n        let r = repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        if !r.missing_refs.is_empty() {\n            println!(\"GC missing_refs: {:?}\", r.missing_refs);\n        }\n        if !r.removed.is_empty() {\n            let bad: Vec<_> = r.removed\n                .iter()\n                .filter(|x| pinned.iter().any(|p| p == *x)\n                    || **x == pa.hash || **x == pb.hash || **x == pbackup.hash)\n                .collect();\n            if !bad.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"!!! GC removed reachable: {bad:?}\");\n                println!(\"    roots now: {:?}\", repo.list_roots().unwrap());\n                println!(\"    pa exists: {} pb exists: {} backup exists: {}\",\n                    repo.block_exists(&pa.hash),\n                    repo.block_exists(&pb.hash),\n                    repo.block_exists(&pbackup.hash));\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    for j in readers { let _ = j.join(); }\n    println!(\"done\");\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_9b0236e1add1c73c73f20e78","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1326,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":128824,"output_tokens":3041,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_5oq3nr6rx3mmfliuxg2xahk0":{"content":"//! The manifest itself is written\n    /// temp + rename, so concurrent readers see either the old or the new root.\n    pub fn put_root(&self, name: &str, hash: &str) -> Result<RootManifest, StoreError> {\n        if !is_valid_root_name(name) {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidRequest(format!(\"bad root name {name:?}\")));\n        }\n        if !is_valid_hash(hash) {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidRequest(format!(\"bad hash {hash:?}\")));\n        }\n        let _guard = self.gc_lock.read().unwrap();\n        if !self.vfs.exists(&self.block_path(hash)) {\n            return Err(StoreError::MissingReference(hash.to_string()));\n        }\n\n        let manifest = RootManifest {\n            root: name.to_string(),\n            hash: hash.to_string(),\n            published_at: now_secs(),\n        };\n        let body = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest)\n            .map_err(|e| StoreError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;\n        // A rename fault here models power loss mid root-switch: the old\n        // manifest remains intact and reachable.\n        atomic_write(\n            self.vfs.as_ref(),\n            &self.roots_dir(),\n            &self.root_path(name),\n            &body,\n        )?;\n        Ok(manifest)\n    }","new_string":"    /// Pin a block as an extra GC root while preparing a publish.\n    ///\n    /// Typical use:\n    ///\n    /// ```ignore\n    /// // build a new tree, then pin its tip before flipping any root, so a\n    /// // concurrent/periodic GC cannot reclaim it in the upload→publish gap\n    /// let _staged = repo.stage(&new_tip)?;\n    /// repo.put_root(\"main\", &new_tip)?; // _staged drops after this\n    /// ```\n    ///\n    /// `put_root` stages its target internally for the duration of the call;\n    /// explicit staging is only needed across multi-step publish protocols.\n    pub fn stage(&self, hash: &str) -> Result<StageGuard, StoreError> {\n        if !is_valid_hash(hash) {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidRequest(format!(\"bad hash {hash:?}\")));\n        }\n        let _guard = self.gc_lock.read().unwrap();\n        if !self.vfs.exists(&self.block_path(hash)) {\n            return Err(StoreError::MissingReference(hash.to_string()));\n        }\n        self.staged.lock().unwrap().insert(hash.to_string());\n        Ok(StageGuard {\n            repo: self.clone(),\n            hash: hash.to_string(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn unstage(&self, hash: &str) {\n        self.staged.lock().unwrap().remove(hash);\n    }\n\n    /// Atomically publish (or repoint) named root `name` at `hash`.\n    ///\n    /// The target is staged for the whole call, guaranteeing that a concurrent\n    /// GC cannot delete it in the gap between the existence check and the\n    /// manifest rename. The root block and every block it references must\n    /// already be present; the manifest is written temp + rename, so readers\n    /// observe either the old or the new root, never a torn one.\n    pub fn put_root(&self, name: &str, hash: &str) -> Result<RootManifest, StoreError> {\n        if !is_valid_root_name(name) {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidRequest(format!(\"bad root name {name:?}\")));\n        }\n        if !is_valid_hash(hash) {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidRequest(format!(\"bad hash {hash:?}\")));\n        }\n        let _guard = self.gc_lock.read().unwrap();\n        if !self.vfs.exists(&self.block_path(hash)) {\n            return Err(StoreError::MissingReference(hash.to_string()));\n        }\n        // Pin across the publish (idempotent if caller staged it too; the\n        // guard only removes its pin on drop if it was the sole owner — using\n        // a per-call bool rather than a count to keep crash semantics simple).\n        let inserted = self.staged.lock().unwrap().insert(hash.to_string());\n\n        let result = self.publish_root_manifest(name, hash);\n        if result.is_err() && inserted {\n            self.unstage(hash);\n        } else if result.is_ok() {\n            // Published: the named root now keeps it alive on its own.\n            if inserted {\n                self.unstage(hash);\n            }\n        }\n        result\n    }\n\n    fn publish_root_manifest(&self, name: &str, hash: &str) -> Result<RootManifest, StoreError> {\n        let manifest = RootManifest {\n            root: name.to_string(),\n            hash: hash.to_string(),\n            published_at: now_secs(),\n        };\n        let body = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest)\n            .map_err(|e| The second mark is\n    ///    authoritative: anything reachable at sweep instant survives.\n    ///\n    /// Because readers hold the read guard for their whole `get_block`, an\n    /// unlinked file cannot be removed out from under an in-flight read.\n    pub fn gc(&self, dry_run: bool) -> Result<GcReport, StoreError> {\n        let _serial = self.gc_run.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Preliminary snapshot (cheap, allows concurrent readers/uploaders).\n        // Its only purpose is to surface \"what existed before the sweep\"; the\n        // authoritative reachability is recomputed under the write guard.\n        let prelim_roots = self.snapshot_roots()?;\n        let prelim_blocks: HashSet<String> = self.enumerate_blocks()?.into_keys().collect();\n        let prelim_starts: Vec<String> = prelim_roots.iter().map(|m| m.hash.clone()).collect();\n        let _ = self.mark_reachable(&prelim_starts, &prelim_blocks);\n\n        // Authoritative phase excludes readers and uploaders.\n        let guard = self.gc_lock.write().unwrap();\n        let roots = self.snapshot_roots()?;\n        // hash -> has_meta\n        let mut blocks = self.enumerate_blocks()?;\n        let all: HashSet<String> = blocks.keys().cloned().collect();\n        let starts: Vec<String> = roots.iter().map(|m| m.hash.clone()).collect();\n        let (reachable, missing_refs) = self.mark_reachable(&starts, &all);\n        if std::env::var(\"CAS_DEBUG_GC\").is_ok() {\n            eprintln!(\"[GC] roots={:?} starts={:?} total={} reachable={}\",\n                roots.iter().map(|m| (m.root.clone(), m.hash[..6].to_string())).collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n                starts.iter().map(|h| h[..6].to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n                all.len(), reachable.len());\n        }\n\n        let mut removed: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        // 1. Sweep unreachable data blocks (and their sidecars alongside).\n        for hash in all.iter() {\n            if reachable.contains(hash) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if dry_run {\n                removed.push(hash.clone());\n                continue;\n            }\n            let data = self.block_path(hash);\n            if self.vfs.exists(&data) {\n                self.vfs\n                    .remove_file(&data)","numLines":45,"startLine":862,"totalLines":1027}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9bf5166c-f255-4f18-8ca2-4f42d12a51f7","session_id":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b","sessionId":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp5-b","slug":"swift-strolling-fairy"}

mut prev: Option<(String, Vec<String>)> = None;\n    for step in 0..6 {\n        let mut leaves = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0..8 {\n            let info = h\n                .repo\n                .add_block(format!(\"tree{step}-leaf{i}\").as_bytes(), &[])\n                .unwrap();\n            leaves.push(info.hash);\n        }\n        let root = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(format!(\"root{step}\").as_bytes(), &leaves)\n            .unwrap();\n        h.repo.put_root(\"live\", &root.hash).unwrap();\n        let report = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        // is reachable. We switch the root step by step and run GC after each\n    // switch; the tree the root points at must always be fully intact.\n    //\n    // NOTE: blocks belonging to *future* trees are legitimately collectable\n    // (nothing references them yet), so each tree is built only when its step\n    // arrives — mirroring a real \"upload tree, then publish\" workflow.\n    let h = mem_repo();\n    let mut prev: Option<(String, Vec<String>)> = None;\n    for step in 0..6 {\n        let mut leaves = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0..8 {\n            let info = h\n                .repo\n                .add_block(format!(\"tree{step}-leaf{i}\").as_bytes(), &[])\n                .unwrap();\n            leaves.push(info.hash);\n        }\n        let root = h\n            .repo\n            .add_block(format!(\"root{step}\").as_bytes(), &leaves)\n            .unwrap();\n        h.repo.put_root(\"live\", &root.hash).unwrap();\n        let report = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        // Currently published tree must be fully intact.\n        for leaf in &leaves {\n            assert!(h.repo.block_exists(leaf), \"step {step}: live leaf deleted\");\n            assert!(!report.removed.contains(leaf));\n        }\n        assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&root.hash));\n        assert!(!report.removed.contains(&root.hash));\n        // The previous tree, now unreachable, must have been collected\n        // (except anything shared — these trees share nothing).\n        if let Some((prev_root, prev_leaves)) = &prev {\n            assert!(!h.repo.block_exists(prev_root));\n            for leaf in prev_leaves {\n                assert!(!h.repo.block_exists(leaf));\n            }\n        }\n        prev = Some((root.hash, leaves));\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn real_fs_gc_and_reopen_roundtrip() {\n    let temp = TempDir::new(\"gc-reopen\");\n    let store = temp.path.join(\"store\");\n    let (keep_hash, junk_hash) = {\n        let repo = Repository::open(&store, Arc::new(RealFs::new())).unwrap();\n        let keep = repo.add_block(b\"keep\", &[]).unwrap();\n        let junk = repo.add_block(b\"junk\", &[]).unwrap();\n        repo.put_root(\"main\", &keep.hash).unwrap();\n        let r = repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(r.removed, vec![junk.hash.clone()]);\n        (keep.hash, junk.hash)\n        // repository dropped: process lock released\n    };\n\n    // Reopen and verify persisted GC result.\n    let repo2 = Repository::open(&store, Arc::new(RealFs::new())).unwrap();\n    assert!(repo2.block_exists(&keep_hash));\n    assert!(!repo2.block_exists(&junk_hash));\n    assert_eq!(repo2.get_root(\"main\").unwrap().hash,
