Scratch reproduction (not a committed test).\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse cas_store::{MemFs, Repository};\nuse cas_store::Vfs;\n\nfn block(seed: u8, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = vec![seed; size];\n    for (i, b) in v.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n        *b = b.wrapping_add((i % 251) as u8);\n    }\n    v\n}\n\nfn main() {\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs).unwrap();\n    let repo = Arc::new(repo);\n\n    let mut pinned = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..40u8 {\n        pinned.push(repo.add_block(&block(i, 128), &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n    let pa = repo.add_block(b\"A\", &pinned[..20]).unwrap();\n    let pb = repo.add_block(b\"B\", &pinned[20..]).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"a\", &pa.hash).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"b\", &pb.hash).unwrap();\n    let pbackup = repo.add_block(b\"backup\", &pinned).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"backup\", &pbackup.hash).unwrap();\n\n    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n\n    // readers\n    let mut readers = vec![];\n    for _ in 0..6 {\n        let repo = repo.clone();\n        let pinned = pinned.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        readers.push(thread::spawn(move || loop {\n            if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { break; }\n            for h in &pinned {\n                let _ = repo.get_block_verified(h);\n            }\n        }));\n    }\n    // switcher\n    {\n        let repo = repo.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        let ha = pa.hash.clone();\n        let hb = pb.hash.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut n = 0;\n            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &hb } else { &ha };\n                if repo.put_root(\"a\", t).is_err() { break; }\n                let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &ha } else { &hb };\n                if repo.put_root(\"b\", t).is_err() { break; }\n                n += 1;\n            }\n        });\n    }\n\n    for sweep in 0..30 {\n        for k in 0..5 {\n            let junk = format!(\"junk-{sweep}-{k}\").into_bytes();\n            let _ = repo.add_block(&junk, &[]);\n        }\n        let r = repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        if !r.missing_refs.is_empty() {\n            println!(\"GC missing_refs: {:?}\", r.missing_refs);\n        }\n        if !r.removed.is_empty() {\n            let bad: Vec<_> = r.removed\n                .iter()\n                .filter(|x| pinned.iter().any(|p| p == *x)\n                    || **x == pa.hash || **x == pb.hash || **x == pbackup.hash)\n                .collect();\n            if !bad.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"!!! GC removed reachable: {bad:?}\");\n                println!(\"    roots now: {:?}\", repo.list_roots().unwrap());\n                println!(\"    pa exists: {} pb exists: {} backup exists: {}\",\n                    repo.block_exists(&pa.hash),\n                    repo.block_exists(&pb.hash),\n                    repo.block_exists(&pbackup.hash));\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    for j in readers { let _ = j.join(); }\n    println!(\"done\");\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":55,"oldLines":8,"newStart":55,"newLines":10,"lines":["             let mut n = 0;","             while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {","                 let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &hb } else { &ha };","+                let _pin = repo.stage(t).unwrap();","                 if repo.put_root(\"a\", t).is_err() { break; }","                 let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &ha } else { &hb };","+                let _pin = repo.stage(t).unwrap();","                 if repo.put_root(\"b\", t).is_err() { break; }","                 n += 1;","             }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3b868829-ef1c-4bc9-833e-d6130e97bcd9","session_id":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b","sessionId":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp5-b","slug":"swift-strolling-fairy"}

Scratch reproduction (not a committed test).\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse cas_store::{MemFs, Repository};\nuse cas_store::Vfs;\n\nfn block(seed: u8, size: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = vec![seed; size];\n    for (i, b) in v.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n        *b = b.wrapping_add((i % 251) as u8);\n    }\n    v\n}\n\nfn main() {\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(MemFs::new());\n    let repo = Repository::open(\"/repo\", vfs).unwrap();\n    let repo = Arc::new(repo);\n\n    let mut pinned = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..40u8 {\n        pinned.push(repo.add_block(&block(i, 128), &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n    let pa = repo.add_block(b\"A\", &pinned[..20]).unwrap();\n    let pb = repo.add_block(b\"B\", &pinned[20..]).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"a\", &pa.hash).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"b\", &pb.hash).unwrap();\n    let pbackup = repo.add_block(b\"backup\", &pinned).unwrap();\n    repo.put_root(\"backup\", &pbackup.hash).unwrap();\n\n    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n\n    // readers\n    let mut readers = vec![];\n    for _ in 0..6 {\n        let repo = repo.clone();\n        let pinned = pinned.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        readers.push(thread::spawn(move || loop {\n            if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { break; }\n            for h in &pinned {\n                let _ = repo.get_block_verified(h);\n            }\n        }));\n    }\n    // switcher\n    {\n        let repo = repo.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        let ha = pa.hash.clone();\n        let hb = pb.hash.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            let mut n = 0;\n            while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &hb } else { &ha };\n                let _pin = repo.stage(t).unwrap();\n                if repo.put_root(\"a\", t).is_err() { break; }\n                let t = if n % 2 == 0 { &ha } else { &hb };\n                let _pin = repo.stage(t).unwrap();\n                if repo.put_root(\"b\", t).is_err() { break; }\n                n += 1;\n            }\n        });\n    }\n\n    for sweep in 0..30 {\n        for k in 0..5 {\n            let junk = format!(\"junk-{sweep}-{k}\").into_bytes();\n            let _ = repo.add_block(&junk, &[]);\n        }\n        let r = repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n        if !r.removed.is_empty() {\n            let pinned_set: std::collections::HashSet<&String> = pinned.iter().collect();\n            let bad_pinned: Vec<_> = r.removed.iter().filter(|x| pinned_set.contains(x)).collect();\n            let bad_roots: Vec<_> = r.removed.iter().filter(|x| {\n                **x == pa.hash || **x == pb.hash || **x == pbackup.hash\n            }).collect();\n            if !bad_pinned.is_empty() || !bad_roots.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"!!! GC removed pinned leaves: {bad_pinned:?}\");\n                println!(\"!!! {"parentUuid":"be9b3f02-9f3d-4aca-8d48-2de23898cf7c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_6bfcce70407142528f129e87","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b/examples/requests.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# cas-store 请求样例：完整走一遍 上传 → 发布根 → 切换根 → GC → 校验。\n# 用法: ./examples/requests.sh [HOST:PORT]   (默认 127.0.0.1:8080)\n# 前置: 已启动  cargo run -- /tmp/cas-demo\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${1:-127.0.0.1:8080}\"\nBASE=\"http://$ADDR\"\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nsay \"0. 健康检查\"\ncurl -s \"$BASE/healthz\"; echo\n\nsay \"1. 上传两个叶子块 (POST /blocks, 服务端算哈希)\"\nL1=$(curl -s -X POST --data-binary 'leaf-one-contents' \"$BASE/blocks\" | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"hash\"])')\nL2=$(curl -s -X POST --data-binary 'leaf-two-contents' \"$BASE/blocks\" | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"hash\"])')\n\nsay \"2. 同内容去重 (再次上传 leaf-one)\"\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary 'leaf-one-contents' \"$BASE/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"3. 上传父块, 通过 X-Refs 声明引用\"\nP=$(curl -s -X POST -H \"X-Refs: $L1,$L2\" --data-binary 'tree-v1' \"$BASE/blocks\" | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"hash\"])')\n\nsay \"4. 内容寻址上传 (PUT /blocks/<hash>, 客户端先算哈希)\"\nDATA='addressed-by-client'\nH=$(printf %s \"$DATA\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\ncurl -s -X PUT --data-binary \"$DATA\" \"$BASE/blocks/$H\"; echo\nsay \"4b. 地址与内容不符 → 400 hash_mismatch\"\ncurl -s -X PUT --data-binary 'tampered' \"$BASE/blocks/$H\"; echo\n\nsay \"5. 下载与存在性检查\"\ncurl -s \"$BASE/blocks/$P\"; echo\ncurl -s -I \"$BASE/blocks/$P\" | head -4\ncurl -s \"$BASE/blocks/$P?verify=1\" >/dev/null && echo \"verify=1 OK\"\n\nsay \"6. 发布根 main -> v1 树\"\ncurl -s -X PUT -H \"X-Block-Hash: $P\" \"$BASE/roots/main\"; echo\n\nsay \"7. 构造 v2 树并切换根 (原子发布)\"\nL3=$(curl -s -X POST --data-binary 'leaf-three' \"$BASE/blocks\" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"hash\"])')\nP2=$(curl -s -X POST -H \"X-Refs: $L1,$L3\" --data-binary 'tree-v2' \"$BASE/blocks\" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"hash\"])')\ncurl -s -X PUT -H \"X-Block-Hash: $P2\" \"$BASE/roots/main\"; echo\ncurl -s \"$BASE/roots\"; echo\n\nsay \"8. 制造孤儿块 (上传但不挂根)\"\nORPHAN=$(curl -s -X POST --data-binary 'never-referenced' \"$BASE/blocks\" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"hash\"])')\necho \"orphan = $ORPHAN\"\n\nsay \"9. GC 预演 (dry_run=1): 只报告, 不删除\"\ncurl -s -X POST \"$BASE/gc?dry_run=1\"; echo\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"orphan still present: %{http_code}\\n\" \"$BASE/blocks/$ORPHAN\"\n\nsay \"10. GC 实扫 (dry_run=0): 孤儿与旧树独有块被回收, 可达块保留\"\ncurl -s -X POST \"$BASE/gc?dry_run=0\"; echo\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"orphan after sweep: %{http_code} (expect 404)\\n\" \"$BASE/blocks/$ORPHAN\"\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"shared leaf L1:  %{http_code} (expect 200)\\n\" \"$BASE/blocks/$L1\"\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"v2-only leaf L3: %{http_code} (expect 200)\\n\" \"$BASE/blocks/$L3\"\ncurl -s -o /dev/null -w \"v1-only leaf L2: %{http_code} (expect 404, 已不可达)\\n\" \"$BASE/blocks/$L2\"\n\nsay \"11. 完整性扫描\"\ncurl -s -X POST \"$BASE/verify\"; echo\n\nsay \"12. 删除根后再次 GC → 全部回收\"\ncurl -s -X DELETE \"$BASE/roots/main\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST \"$BASE/gc?dry_run=0\"; echo\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d4b275ded779afc65b3bafb2","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":4004,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":143360,"output_tokens":1316,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_6bfcce70407142528f129e87":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# cas-store 请求样例：完整走一遍 上传 → 发布根 → 切换根 → GC → 校验。\n# 用法: ./examples/requests.sh [HOST:PORT]   (默认 127.0.0.1:8080)\n# 前置: 已启动  cargo run -- /tmp/cas-demo\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${1:-127.0.0.1:8080}\"\nBASE=\"http://$ADDR\"\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; {"type":"last-prompt","lastPrompt":"从空目录开发“内容寻址块仓库”纯后端项目。用Rust实现文件支持的存储库及本地HTTP验证入口，明确磁盘格式和同步边界；用可注入I/O层模拟故障。实现按SHA256存储不可变块和具名根；同内容去重，根更新原子发布，标记清扫与读取并发时保护活跃根，哈希仅作完整性校验。验收：并发上传同块，制造孤儿块、缺失引用及根切换中断，验证可达块不会被误删。交付源码、README、请求样例与自动化测试；实际运行并如…","leafUuid":"b74ec728-beb8-4bd9-99ae-d6f8cdf0d8b2","sessionId":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c"}

{"parentUuid":"4e5c4b06-d013-4b6c-ab06-45d985e7c037","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_0e676a4305964d7b926ea713","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b/README.md","content":"# cas-store — 内容寻址块仓库（纯后端）\n\n一个用 Rust 实现的、文件系统支持的内容寻址（content-addressable）块存储：\n\n- 按 **SHA-256** 存储**不可变块**，同内容自动**去重**；\n- **具名根（named roots）** 指向块图，根更新通过临时文件 + rename **原子发布**；\n- **标记-清扫 GC** 回收孤儿块，与并发读取/上传/根切换安全共存——**可达块永不误删**；\n- 哈希只用于**寻址、去重与完整性校验**，不作为安全/信任边界；\n- 所有磁盘 I/O 经过**可注入的 `Vfs` 层**，测试用 `FaultFs` 精确注入故障（如\"根切换 rename 瞬间崩溃\"）。\n\n无 Web 框架、无异步运行时：HTTP 验证入口是手写的极简 HTTP/1.1 服务（每连接一线程，单请求/连接）。\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build\ncargo test                      # 45 个测试（含并发与故障注入）\ncargo run -- /tmp/cas-data      # 启动服务, 默认 127.0.0.1:8080\ncargo run -- /tmp/cas-data --addr 0.0.0.0:9000\n```\n\n请求样例（完整走通上传→发布→切换→GC→校验）：\n\n```bash\n./examples/requests.sh                    # 正常流程\n./examples/corrupt_and_verify.sh /tmp/cas-data   # 篡改磁盘块 → /verify 发现\ncargo run --example gc_concurrent_demo    # 并发混沌演示（读+切根+GC 同时进行）\n```\n\n## 磁盘格式（`cas-store v1`）\n\n```\n<repo>/\n  format                      # 一行 \"cas-store v1\\n\"，不符则拒绝打开\n  repo.lock                   # flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) 目标，进程级单写者\n  blocks/\n    ab/\n      <64-hex>                # 块原始字节，发布后不可变\n      <64-hex>.meta           # JSON: {\"refs\": [\"<hash>\", ...]}，声明出边\n  roots/\n    <root-name>               # JSON: {\"root\",\"hash\",\"published_at\"}，原子发布\n  tmp/                        # 预留\n```\n\n- 块数据与 `.meta`、根清单都经 **唯一临时文件 + fsync + rename** 原子发布；\n  中断只可能留下 `.tmp.*` 残文件，**绝不会**在内容地址上出现撕裂文件；\n  残文件在下次 `open` 时清扫。\n- 块文件创建后永不修改（rename 覆盖只发生在同内容去重竞争时，字节必然相同）。\n- `.meta` 是可选的边信息：缺失视为无出边（叶子块合法）；孤儿 `.meta` 会被 GC 清理。\n\n## 同步边界（明确声明）\n\n| 边界 | 机制 |\n|---|---|\n| **进程间** | 单写者：`open` 时对 `repo.lock` 取非阻塞排他 `flock`；第二个进程得到 `Locked` 错误。读者进程不在设计内（需要时自行加只读模式）。 |\n| **进程内线程** | 任意线程并发读/写。上传、发布、读取持 `gc_lock` 读守卫；GC 仅在**最终标记+清扫**阶段持写守卫（排他）。读操作在整个读取期间持有读守卫，清扫无法把正在服务的字节从读端抽走。 |\n| **崩溃** | temp+fsync+rename：观察者只能看到旧文件或新文件。根切换在 rename 瞬间崩溃 → 旧根完好（有专门故障注入测试）。 |\n| **哈希** | SHA-256 仅用于寻址/去重/完整性。上传不认证；`?verify=1` 与 `/verify` 提供完整性校验。 |\n\n### GC 并发协议\n\n1. 读守卫下做一次预标记（仅用于报告）；\n2. 写守卫下**重新**快照根、重新标记（权威），然后删除不可达块。\n   权威标记发生在排他窗口内，因此\"标记时可达、清扫时被删\"不可能发生。\n3. **暂存（staging）**：`Repository::stage(hash)` 把\"已上传、尚未挂根\"的块\n   固定为临时 GC 根（引用计数，RAII 守卫）。`put_root` 内部对目标自动\n   暂存。没有它，\"上传完成→根切换\"间隙里的 GC 合法回收未来根是符合\n   语义但违反直觉的行为——这是本仓库明确处理的一个真实竞态。\n\n## HTTP API\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| POST | `/blocks` | 上传原始字节（`X-Refs: h1,h2` 声明引用）；或 JSON `{\"data\":\"<hex>\",\"refs\":[...]}` |\n| PUT | `/blocks/<sha256>` | 内容寻址上传，地址与内容不符 → 400 `hash_mismatch` |\n| GET | `/blocks/<sha256>` | 下载；`?verify=1` 重哈希校验，损坏 → 422 |\n| HEAD | `/blocks/<sha256>` | 存在性 + 大小（`X-Content-Sha256`） |\n| PUT | `/roots/<name>` | 原子发布/切换根（`X-Block-Hash` 头或 JSON `{\"hash\":...}`）；目标缺失 → 409 |\n| GET | `/roots` `/roots/<name>` | 列出 / 读取根 |\n| DELETE | `/roots/<name>` | 删除根（其独占块成为 GC 候选） |\n| POST | `/gc?dry_run=0\\|1` | 标记-清扫（默认 `dry_run=1` 只报告） |\n| POST | `/verify` | 全量完整性扫描（重哈希 + 悬空引用） |\n| GET | `/healthz` `/` | 存活 / 帮助 |\n\n错误统一为 JSON：`{\"error\": \"<code>\", \"message\": \"...\"}`，状态码映射：\n400 请求非法/hash 不匹配，404 不存在，409 引用缺失/仓库被锁，422 内容损坏，500 内部错误。\n\n## 可注入 I/O 层与故障演练\n\n`src/vfs.rs` 定义 `Vfs` trait，三个实现：\n\n- `RealFs` — 生产后端（O_EXCL、fsync、目录 fsync）；\n- `MemFs` — 纯内存后端，并发测试零临时目录；\n- `FaultFs` — 装饰器，按规则注入故障：\n  `Fault { path_contains, op: Rename|Write|Create, once: Some(n) }`。\n  rename 故障**故意留下临时文件**，精确模拟\"数据已写、rename 未发\"的崩溃点。\n\n## 验收场景 → 测试对照\n\n| 验收项 | 测试 |\n|---|---|\n| 并发上传同一块 | `gc.rs::concurrent_uploads_of_same_block_deduplicate`（16 线程）、`http_api.rs::concurrent_clients_uploading_same_block` |\n| 孤儿块回收 | `gc.rs::dry_run_reports_but_keeps_everything` / `sweep_removes_orphan_only` |\n| 缺失引用 | `gc.rs::missing_refs_are_reported_not_fatal_and_reachable_set_is_protected`（外部删块造洞，GC 报告不误删可达块） |\n| 根切换中断 | `roots.rs::root_publish_crash_leaves_old_root_intact`（FaultFs 在第二次 rename 注入崩溃，旧根完好） |\n| 可达块不误删（GC×读×切根并发） | `gc.rs::gc_never_removes_blocks_read_while_sweeping`（6 读线程 + 2 切根线程 + 30 轮 GC）、`gc_with_concurrent_root_switch_...` |\n| 完整性 | `faults.rs::corrupted_block_on_disk_is_detected` 等 |\n| 进程锁 | `gc.rs::opening_twice_is_rejected_by_process_lock` |\n\n运行记录见 [RUNLOG.md](RUNLOG.md)。\n\n## 已知限制\n\n- HTTP 层是验证入口而非生产网关：单请求/连接、无 TLS、无认证、请求体上限 64 MiB。\n- 单写者进程；跨进程并发写不在设计内（flock 直接拒绝）。\n- 暂存（staging）是进程内状态：进程崩溃后未发布的上传成为普通孤儿，由下次 GC 回收（语义安全）。\n- 块整体读入内存；未做流式/分块上传。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_a262586eec2a0f6eca0ef151","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1842,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":147456,"output_tokens":2024,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_0e676a4305964d7b926ea713":{"content":"# {"parentUuid":"86657423-e74f-4088-946e-a607f2681c00","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_f6d7b7a69e954673b85b1487","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b/RUNLOG.md","content":"# RUNLOG — 实际运行记录\n\n环境：Linux 6.8.0-90-generic (Ubuntu 24.04)，rustc 1.98.1 / cargo 1.98.1。\n所有命令在仓库根目录执行。日期：2026-09-23。\n\n## 1. 构建\n\n```\n$ cargo build            → Finished dev profile（0 警告）\n$ cargo build --release  → Finished release profile [optimized] in 11.23s\n```\n\n## 2. 自动化测试（最终结果）\n\n```\n$ cargo test\n  unittests src/lib.rs   6 passed\n  unittests src/main.rs  0 passed\n  tests/blocks.rs        9 passed\n  tests/faults.rs        6 passed\n  tests/gc.rs           11 passed\n  tests/http_api.rs      7 passed\n  doc-tests              0 passed, 1 ignored（文档中的 ignore 示例）\n  合计 45 passed, 0 failed\n```\n\n稳定性复跑：`tests/gc.rs::gc_never_removes_blocks_read_while_sweeping`\n（6 读线程 + 2 切根线程 + 30 轮 GC）连续 10 次全部通过；\n完整套件连续 3 次全部通过。\n\n### 开发过程中出现并已修复的失败（如实记录）\n\n1. **死锁**：`merge_meta` 持有 `meta_lock` 又调用再次加锁的 `write_meta`\n   （std Mutex 不可重入），`identical_content_deduplicates` 等 2 个测试挂起。\n   gdb 抓栈定位后改为调用 `_locked` 变体，删除重复加锁函数。\n2. **测试自身错误**：`refs_are_stored_and_traversed` 误用真实存在的哈希当\n   \"缺失引用\"；`reopen_persists...` 与 `real_fs_gc_and_reopen_roundtrip`\n   在旧仓库未 drop（flock 未释放）时重开 → `Locked`。均已修正测试。\n3. **真实并发缺陷（重要）**：并发\"根切换 + GC\"场景中，当两个根瞬时指向\n   同一棵树时，另一棵树的根块**合法地**不可达并被 GC 回收，随后切回失败\n   （`MissingReference`）。这不是标记/清扫的互斥问题（读守卫验证 40 个\n   叶子从未被误删），而是\"已上传、未挂根\"目标缺少保护的语义缺口。\n   修复：引入**暂存（staging）**机制——`Repository::stage()` RAII 守卫 +\n   `put_root` 内部自动暂存，GC 权威标记把 staged 集合并入根集合。\n   同时修正测试场景（backup 根原本只固定叶子、未固定树根 A/B）。\n4. **HTTP HEAD**：`Content-Length` 被空 body 覆盖为 0 → `write_response`\n   改为尊重显式头。\n5. **故障注入语义**：写故障后 `MemWriter` 的 Drop 仍把残数据发布到内容\n   地址 → 块数据改为 temp+rename 原子发布，写失败时清理临时文件。\n\n## 3. 端到端演示（真实进程 + curl）\n\n```\n$ cargo run -- /tmp/cas-demo --addr 127.0.0.1:18099   # 后台启动\n$ ./examples/requests.sh 127.0.0.1:18099\n```\n\n关键结果（完整输出见会话记录）：\n\n- 上传/去重：`deduplicated: false → true`，哈希一致；\n- `PUT /blocks/<hash>` 地址不符 → `400 {\"error\":\"hash_mismatch\"}`；\n- 发布根 `main`→v1，切换到 v2，`GET /roots` 反映新值；\n- 孤儿块（未挂根）在 `dry_run=1` 中列出但不删（`orphan still present: 200`）；\n- `dry_run=0` 后：孤儿 404，共享叶 L1 200，v2 叶 L3 200，v1 独有叶 L2 404\n  （切换后不可达，**符合预期**）；`reachable: 3` 与 v2 树一致；\n- 删除根后再 GC：3 个剩余块全部回收，`blocks_total: 0`。\n\n### 故障演练\n\n```\n$ ./examples/corrupt_and_verify.sh /tmp/cas-demo 127.0.0.1:18099\n  篡改磁盘块首字节 → 普通 GET 返回损坏字节（存储层不主动重哈希）\n  → GET ?verify=1 → 422 {\"error\":\"corrupt\"}\n  → POST /verify → corrupt: [\"f6b0c08f...\"]  ✔\n```\n\n### 磁盘格式 / 进程锁 / 崩溃恢复\n\n```\n$ find /tmp/cas-demo -type f\n  blocks/f6/f6b0c08f...  blocks/f6/f6b0c08f....meta  format  repo.lock\n$ cat /tmp/cas-demo/format → cas-store v1\n$ ./target/debug/cas-store /tmp/cas-demo   # 第二个进程\n  → failed to open repository: repository is locked by another process ✔\n$ touch blocks/f6/.tmp.999.crashed && 重启服务\n  → .tmp 残留被 open 清扫；仓库正常服务；此前标记的 corrupt 块仍被 /verify 报告 ✔\n```\n\n### 并发混沌演示\n\n```\n$ cargo run --example gc_concurrent_demo\n  6 读线程(verified read) + 1 切根线程(stage+put_root) + 30 轮 GC(每轮先造 5 个孤儿)\n  → 无任何可达块被删；孤儿全部被回收；输出 \"done\"，退出码 0 ✔\n```\n\n## 4. 未通过项 / 已知限制（最终状态）\n\n- 测试：**无未通过项**（45/45 通过，1 个文档示例按约定 ignore）。\n- 功能限制（设计内，见 README「已知限制」）：HTTP 层单请求/连接、无 TLS/\n  认证；单写者进程；staging 为进程内状态（崩溃后未发布块成为孤儿，语义\n  安全）；块整体入内存，无流式上传。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_4a9ca0a33b6dd87453310c36","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1296,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":155648,"output_tokens":1656,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_f6d7b7a69e954673b85b1487":{"content":"# Mark-sweep GC: orphans, missing refs, shared blocks and the core safety\n2\t//! invariant — blocks reachable from a live root are never deleted, even under\n3\t//! concurrent reads and root switches.\n4\t\n5\tmod common;\n6\t\n7\tuse std::collections::HashSet;\n8\tuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};\n9\tuse std::sync::Arc;\n10\tuse std::thread;\n11\t\n12\tuse cas_store::{RealFs, Repository};\n13\tuse common::{block, both_backends, mem_repo, RepoHarness, TempDir};\n14\t\n15\t/// Two disjoint trees sharing one common leaf.\n16\t/// Returns (tree_a_root, tree_b_root, shared_leaf, orphan_root, all_hashes).\n17\tfn build_scene(h: &RepoHarness) -> Scene {\n18\t    let leaf_a = h.repo.add_block(block(1, 20).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n19\t    let leaf_b = h.repo.add_block(block(2, 20).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n20\t    let shared = h.repo.add_block(block(3, 20).as_slice(), &[]).unwrap();\n21\t\n22\t    let ra = h\n23\t        .repo\n24\t        .add_block(\n25\t            b\"treeA\",\n26\t            &[leaf_a.hash.clone(), shared.hash.clone()],\n27\t        )\n28\t        .unwrap();\n29\t    let rb = h\n30\t        .repo\n31\t        .add_block(\n32\t            b\"treeB\",\n33\t            &[leaf_b.hash.clone(), shared.hash.clone()],\n34\t        )\n35\t        .unwrap();\n36\t    // Orphan: uploaded, never attached to any root.\n37\t    let orphan = h.repo.add_block(b\"floating\", &[]).unwrap();\n38\t\n39\t    h.repo.put_root(\"a\", &ra.hash).unwrap();\n40\t    h.repo.put_root(\"b\", &rb.hash).unwrap();\n41\t\n42\t    Scene {\n43\t        root_a: ra.hash,\n44\t        root_b: rb.hash,\n45\t        leaf_a: leaf_a.hash,\n46\t        leaf_b: leaf_b.hash,\n47\t        shared: shared.hash,\n48\t        orphan: orphan.hash,\n49\t    }\n50\t}\n51\t\n52\tstruct Scene {\n53\t    root_a: String,\n54\t    root_b: String,\n55\t    leaf_a: String,\n56\t    leaf_b: String,\n57\t    shared: String,\n58\t    orphan: String,\n59\t}\n60\t\n61\t#[test]\n62\tfn dry_run_reports_but_keeps_everything() {\n63\t    both_backends(|h| {\n64\t        let s = build_scene(h);\n65\t        let r = h.repo.gc(true).unwrap();\n66\t        assert!(r.dry_run);\n67\t        assert_eq!(r.blocks_total, 6);\n68\t        assert_eq!(r.reachable, 5);\n69\t        assert_eq!(r.orphan, 1);\n70\t        assert_eq!(r.removed, vec![s.orphan.clone()]);\n71\t        assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&s.orphan), \"dry-run must not delete\");\n72\t    });\n73\t}\n74\t\n75\t#[test]\n76\tfn sweep_removes_orphan_only() {\n77\t    both_backends(|h| {\n78\t        let s = build_scene(h);\n79\t        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n80\t        assert!(!r.dry_run);\n81\t        assert_eq!(r.removed, vec![s.orphan.clone()]);\n82\t        assert!(!h.repo.block_exists(&s.orphan));\n83\t        // Everything reachable survives.\n84\t        for alive in [\n85\t            &s.root_a, &s.root_b, &s.leaf_a, &s.leaf_b, &s.shared,\n86\t        ] {\n87\t            assert!(h.repo.block_exists(alive), \"{alive} must survive\");\n88\t        }\n89\t    });\n90\t}\n91\t\n92\t#[test]\n93\tfn shared_leaf_survives_until_no_root_reaches_it() {\n94\t    both_backends(|h| {\n95\t        let s = build_scene(h);\n96\t        // Delete root a: leaf_a becomes garbage; shared is still reached by b.\n97\t        h.repo.delete_root(\"a\").unwrap();\n98\t        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n99\t        let removed: HashSet<&str> = r.removed.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();\n100\t        // orphan from scene + root_a + leaf_a\n101\t        assert!(removed.contains(s.orphan.as_str()));\n102\t        assert!(removed.contains(s.root_a.as_str()));\n103\t        assert!(removed.contains(s.leaf_a.as_str()));\n104\t        assert!(!removed.contains(s.shared.as_str()), \"shared still reached by root b\");\n105\t        assert!(!removed.contains(s.leaf_b.as_str()));\n106\t        assert!(!removed.contains(s.root_b.as_str()));\n107\t\n108\t        // Delete root b as well: the rest is collected.\n109\t        h.repo.delete_root(\"b\").unwrap();\n110\t        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n111\t        let removed: HashSet<String> = r.removed.into_iter().collect();\n112\t        assert!(removed.contains(&s.shared));\n113\t        assert!(removed.contains(&s.leaf_b));\n114\t        assert!(removed.contains(&s.root_b));\n115\t        assert_eq!(h.repo.verify().unwrap().blocks_total, 0);\n116\t    });\n117\t}\n118\t\n119\t#[test]\n120\tfn root_switch_away_makes_old_tree_garbage_and_new_tree_live() {\n121\t    both_backends(|h| {\n122\t        let s = build_scene(h);\n123\t        // Switch root a from treeA onto treeB's root.\n124\t        h.repo.put_root(\"a\", &s.root_b).unwrap();\n125\t        let r = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n126\t        let removed: HashSet<&str> = r.removed.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();\n127\t        // leaf_a / root_a / orphan are now unreachable; shared still live.\n128\t        assert!(removed.contains(s.root_a.as_str()));\n129\t        assert!(removed.contains(s.leaf_a.as_str()));\n130\t        assert!(removed.contains(s.orphan.as_str()));\n131\t        assert!(!removed.contains(s.shared.as_str()));\n132\t    });\n133\t}\n134\t\n135\t#[test]\n136\tfn missing_refs_are_reported_not_fatal_and_reachable_set_is_protected() {\n137\t    // Manufacture a missing reference directly on the backend:\n138\t    // root block's meta points at a child, then the child data is removed out\n139\t    // from underneath (simulating lost files / partial replication).\n140\t    let h = mem_repo();\n141\t    let child = h.repo.add_block(b\"child\", &[]).unwrap();\n142\t    let root = h\n143\t        .repo\n144\t        .add_block(b\"root\", &[child.hash.clone()])\n145\t        .unwrap();\n146\t    h.repo.put_root(\"main\", &root.hash).unwrap();\n147\t\n148\t    // Delete the child block and its sidecar *externally* via the same Vfs\n149\t    // (bypassing repository rules), creating a dangling edge.\n150\t    let child_path = h\n151\t        .repo\n152\t        .path()\n153\t        .join(\"blocks\")\n154\t        .join(&child.hash[0..2])\n155\t        .join(&child.hash);\n156\t    let child_meta = h\n157\t        .repo\n158\t        .path()\n159\t        .join(\"blocks\")\n160\t        .join(&child.hash[0..2])\n161\t        .join(format!(\"{}.meta\", child.hash));\n162\t    h.vfs.remove_file(&child_path).unwrap();\n163\t    h.vfs.remove_file(&child_meta).unwrap();\n164\t\n165\t    let verify = h.repo.verify().unwrap();\n166\t    let dangling: Vec<_> = verify\n167\t        .missing_refs\n168\t        .iter()\n169\t        .filter(|m| m.from == root.hash && m.target == child.hash)\n170\t        .collect();\n171\t    assert_eq!(dangling.len(), 1);\n172\t\n173\t    // GC must still run: the root itself is reachable and MUST be preserved;\n174\t    // the hole is reported.\n175\t    let gc = h.repo.gc(false).unwrap();\n176\t    assert!(h.repo.block_exists(&root.hash), \"reachable root must survive hole\");\n177\t    assert!(\n178\t        gc.missing_refs\n179\t            .iter()\n180\t            .any(|m| m.from == root.hash && m.target == child.hash),\n181\t        \"GC should report the dangling edge: {:?}\",\n182\t        gc.missing_refs\n183\t    );\n184\t    assert!(!gc.removed.contains(&root.hash));\n185\t\n186\t    // Root pointing directly at a missing block: reported as <root> edge and\n187\t    // nothing panics.\n188\t    h.repo.delete_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n189\t    // Re-publish isn't allowed (block missing), so plant manifest externally:\n190\t    let manifest = serde_json::json!({\n191\t        \"root\": \"ghost\", \"hash\": child.hash, \"published_at\": 0\n192\t    });\n193\t    let roots_dir = h.repo.path().join(\"roots\");\n194\t    let tmp = roots_dir.join(\".tmp.plant\");\n195\t    use std::io::Write;\n196\t    let mut f = h.vfs.create_new(&tmp).unwrap();\n197\t    f.write_all(&serde_json::to_vec(&manifest).unwrap()).unwrap();\n198\t    drop(f);\n199\t    h.vfs.rename(&tmp, {"parentUuid":"a92cb730-d6d4-4c86-85c8-10f61d01ce4d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"项目完成。最终交付概览：\n\n## 交付内容\n\n**`cas-store`** — 内容寻址块仓库（纯后端，Rust，约 3900 行），全部 45 个测试通过、零警告。\n\n### 架构\n- **`src/vfs.rs`** — 可注入 I/O 层 `Vfs` trait + 三个后端：`RealFs`（生产）、`MemFs`（内存，并发测试用）、`FaultFs`（故障注入装饰器，可按路径/操作/次数注入 rename/write/create 故障）\n- **`src/store.rs`** — 核心引擎：SHA-256 寻址不可变块、同内容去重、具名根原子发布（temp+fsync+rename）、标记-清扫 GC、完整性扫描、**staging 暂存机制**\n- **`src/server.rs`** — 零依赖手写 HTTP/1.1 验证入口（每连接一线程），`src/main.rs` 为 CLI\n\n### 关键设计（README 有完整文档）\n- **磁盘格式 `cas-store v1`**：`blocks/<2位前缀>/<hash>` + `.meta` 引用边、`roots/<name>` JSON 清单、`repo.lock` 进程锁\n- **同步边界**：进程间 flock 单写者；进程内 RwLock（GC 仅在最终标记+清扫持写锁，读者全程持读锁）；崩溃边界 temp+rename；哈希仅作完整性校验\n- **staging**：`put_root` 自动暂存目标块，消除\"已上传未挂根\"被 GC 合法回收的竞态\n\n### 验收场景 → 实测\n| 验收项 | 结果 |\n|---|---|\n| 并发上传同块（16 线程 + 12 HTTP 客户端） | ✅ 全部解析为同一哈希，磁盘仅 1 块 |\n| 孤儿块 | ✅ dry_run 只报告，实扫回收，端到端 curl 验证 |\n| 缺失引用 | ✅ 外部删块造洞后 GC 报告 `missing_refs` 且不误删可达块 |\n| 根切换中断 | ✅ FaultFs 在 rename 瞬间注入崩溃，旧根完好，重试成功 |\n| 可达块不误删 | ✅ 6 读线程 + 2 切根线程 + 30 轮 GC 并发，连跑 10 次稳定通过 |\n\n### 开发中如实记录的失败（详见 RUNLOG.md）\n1. `meta_lock` 重入死锁（gdb 定位修复）；2. 三个测试自身错误；3. **真实并发缺陷**：根切换间隙目标块被 GC 合法回收 → 引入 staging 机制修复；4. HEAD 的 Content-Length bug；5. 写故障后残数据发布问题 → 块数据改 temp+rename 原子发布。\n\n### 运行方式\n```bash\ncargo test                              # 45 个测试\ncargo run -- /tmp/cas-data              # 启动服务\n./examples/requests.sh                  # 完整请求样例\n./examples/corrupt_and_verify.sh /tmp/cas-data   # 篡改检测演练\ncargo run --example gc_concurrent_demo  # 并发混沌演示\n```\n\n文件未提交 git（未收到提交指示），工作区已就绪，需要的话我可以立即提交。","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_167b3e1e5ee80dd04fe3a81b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":949,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":163840,"output_tokens":785,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"9782b612-0c5a-4086-a434-511e81a54d01","timestamp":"2026-09-23T04:43:32.232Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/b","sessionId":"1697808c-b59c-413d-a9aa-4db0d293392c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp5-b","slug":"swift-strolling-fairy"}
